description: The 'dss_apps_live' dataset provides comprehensive information about live applications, focusing on their visibility, version, and usage. This dataset is particularly useful for managing and analyzing applications within a software ecosystem, such as Dataiku. It includes details like unique application identifiers, version information, and descriptive labels, which help in identifying and categorizing applications. The dataset also contains metadata such as tags, origin, and instance count, which are crucial for understanding the deployment and usage patterns of these applications. Additionally, it provides URLs for direct access to the applications, enhancing usability for developers and administrators. The boolean fields indicate specific attributes like limited visibility, presence of an image, and usage as a recipe, which are essential for application management and user interface considerations. This dataset is valuable for IT administrators, data scientists, and business analysts who need to monitor application performance, manage resources, and optimize application deployment strategies.
shortDesc: Dataset of live applications with visibility, version, and usage details.

columns.name: onlyLimitedVisibility
columns.comment: Indicates if app has limited visibility, boolean value.

columns.name: appId
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each application, text format.

columns.name: appVersion
columns.comment: Version information of the application, text format.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Descriptive label for the application, free text.

columns.name: shortDesc
columns.comment: Short description of the application, free text.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the application, JSON array format.

columns.name: isAppImg
columns.comment: Indicates if app has an image, boolean value.

columns.name: origin
columns.comment: Source of the application, either project or plugin.

columns.name: originProjectKey
columns.comment: Key of the originating project, text format.

columns.name: instanceCount
columns.comment: Number of instances of the application, integer value.

columns.name: useAsRecipe
columns.comment: Indicates if app is used as a recipe, boolean value.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for accessing the application, string format.
